home.feature_route_planning_desc: Optimize routes in seconds with advanced algorithms that consider distance, traffic, fuel costs, and delivery windows.
home.feature_tracking_desc: Monitor every vehicle in your fleet with live GPS tracking, geofencing, and instant alerts.
home.feature_dispatch_desc: Assign jobs automatically based on driver availability, truck status, and proximity.
home.feature_ocr_desc: Scan and digitize invoices, CMRs, and receipts with AI-powered OCR.
home.feature_analytics_desc: Gain actionable insights with dashboards, KPIs, and customizable reports.
home.feature_driver_desc: Manage driver profiles, licenses, medical certificates, and performance.
home.benefit_cost_desc: Cut fuel consumption by up to 20%% with optimized routing, reduce idle time, and minimize maintenance costs.
home.benefit_speed_desc: Complete more deliveries per day with intelligent route optimization and real-time traffic avoidance.
home.benefit_paperwork_desc: Digitize all documents with OCR, automate invoicing, and go fully paperless.
home.benefit_scale_desc: From 5 vehicles to 500, our platform grows with your business without missing a beat.
home.testimonial_1: Operion transformed our operations. We cut route planning time by 80%% and fuel costs by 15%% in the first quarter.
home.testimonial_2: Having real-time visibility into our fleet has been a game-changer. Our customers love the accurate ETAs.
home.testimonial_3: We scaled from 10 to 50 vehicles without adding a single dispatcher. Operion's automation is incredible.
home.hero_description: Operion ERP gives your fleet the power to plan smarter, dispatch faster, and grow bigger.
home.section_features: Everything you need to run your fleet
home.section_features_desc: Powerful tools that work together to streamline every aspect of your logistics operations.
home.section_benefits_desc: Every feature is designed to solve a real problem our customers faced.
home.section_testimonials_desc: See how Operion is helping companies transform their logistics operations.
home.section_mission_desc: Our mission is to make enterprise logistics software accessible, powerful, and easy to use.
home.section_cta_desc: Join hundreds of companies that trust Operion to run their fleet operations.

features.page_header_desc: Everything you need to run your fleet efficiently, from route planning to analytics.
features.route_planning_desc: Advanced algorithms optimize for time, distance, fuel, and toll costs across Europe.
features.multi_stop_desc: Plan complex multi-stop routes with up to 50 waypoints and automated sequencing.
features.traffic_desc: Routes adjust dynamically based on live traffic conditions and road closures.
features.gps_tracking_desc: Monitor every vehicle's location, speed, and status on an interactive map.
features.maintenance_desc: Schedule and track maintenance with automated alerts for inspections, insurance, and services.
features.geofencing_desc: Set geographic boundaries and receive instant notifications when vehicles enter or leave zones.
features.auto_assign_desc: Match jobs to the best available drivers and trucks based on location, skills, and compliance.
features.pod_desc: Capture signatures, photos, and timestamps at delivery for complete proof of delivery.
features.status_updates_desc: Track every job from assignment to completion with live status updates.
features.ocr_ai_desc: Scan and digitize invoices, CMRs, receipts, and contracts with AI-powered OCR.
features.digital_archive_desc: Store and search all documents with version history, tags, and full-text search.
features.auto_invoicing_desc: Generate invoices from delivery data automatically and email them to clients.
features.dashboards_desc: Build personalized views with KPIs, charts, and real-time data.
features.kpi_desc: Monitor key performance indicators including profit per mile, fuel efficiency, and driver performance.
features.export_desc: Export reports in multiple formats and integrate with your existing ERP and accounting software.
features.driver_profiles_desc: Complete driver database with licenses, medical certificates, contracts, and documents.
features.driver_performance_desc: Monitor driver efficiency, safety scores, tachograph compliance, and driving hours.
features.schedule_desc: Plan driver shifts, manage availability, and track working hours.

about.page_header_desc: We're building the future of enterprise logistics software.
about.story_p1: Operion was founded in 2024 with a clear mission: make enterprise-grade logistics software accessible to fleets of all sizes.
about.story_p2: Our team combines decades of experience in logistics, software engineering, and AI to build tools that solve real-world problems.
about.story_p3: Today, Operion powers fleets across Europe, helping them plan smarter, dispatch faster, and grow bigger.
about.values_desc: The principles that guide every decision we make.
about.value_customer_desc: Every feature we build starts with real customer needs and feedback.
about.value_reliability_desc: Your operations depend on our software. We take that responsibility seriously.
about.value_innovation_desc: We invest heavily in R&D to bring cutting-edge AI and optimization to logistics.
about.value_transparency_desc: Clear pricing, honest communication, and no hidden fees.
about.value_security_desc: Enterprise-grade encryption, GDPR compliance, and regular security audits.
about.value_partnership_desc: We don't just sell software. We partner with our customers for their success.
about.team_desc: Our team combines decades of experience in logistics, software engineering, and AI.
